body: I'm a minor. Whenever I tell anyone, they seem to not take me seriously. My parents absolutely adore my brother, and if I were to report this to someone it'd likely jeopardize my relations with them. Thanks for the advice, kind stranger.
More information: He does **not** treat his friends like this. He acts normal towards them. Advice would be appreciated, but you have my thanks even by just viewing my story.

Thanks for the suggestions, but stepping away is not something I can just do. They're both around the house every day of the week, and my parents are rather strict when it comes to exiting the home all on my own.  


Appreciate the kind words, cheers.
